name: 34224 · Englewood, FL
findings: ZIP 34224 (Englewood) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34224 (Englewood) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 34224 (Englewood) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
